ad_library.summary: Galaxy Dental Care advertises hardest of the five and measures least. Five active Meta ads were read today, the newest opened 5 October 2026, and the Google Ads Transparency Centre returns roughly 300 live ads - but every one of them is registered to the advertiser name 'Jaydeep', not to the clinic, and each Meta ad opens WhatsApp or Instagram, never the website. On the site, the offers do not survive the click: the ads quote Rs. 20,000 braces and Rs. 15,000 implants, while the contact page publishes no price at all. The page is also the heaviest in the batch - 192 validator errors, nine broken paragraph nestings, and 28 iframes sized with width="100%" - and its NABH, ISO and FAMDENT trust badges are lazy-loaded images, so a visitor whose connection stalls sees empty boxes where the accreditations should be. Google Tag Manager (GTM-TRRMQGQ) is installed but deferred by WP Rocket until the first interaction, and the page emits no JSON-LD at all.

scope_note: Re-read on 2026-11-28 line by line through the W3C checker's source view: the 1,997-line document was read in full, head and footer. Google Tag Manager GTM-TRRMQGQ is in the head but WP Rocket rewrites it to type="rocketlazyloadscript", deferring it to the first user interaction. WP Rocket also preconnects to connect.facebook.net, scripts.clarity.ms, googleads.g.doubleclick.net, www.googletagmanager.com and clickcease.com - preconnects it derives from scripts it found - yet no fbq, gtag, G- or AW- id exists anywhere in the markup, so the live tag inventory sits inside GTM and is account-only. The appointment form is genuine (dental-appointment-ajax: name, phone, email, branch, a hidden 'website' honeypot, Google reCAPTCHA v3) and a scroll-triggered popup opens at 50% page depth. Yoast SEO 28.9 writes the title, description, canonical, Open Graph and Twitter tags but emits no JSON-LD on this URL. The form was not submitted.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data
